compounds.name: Peracetic acid
compounds.info: Peracetic acid is a peroxy acid that is acetic acid in which the OH group is substituted by a hydroperoxy group. It is a versatile oxidising agent that is used as a disinfectant.

compounds.name: Acetyl chloride
compounds.info: Acetyl chloride is an acyl chloride. It is functionally related to an acetic acid.

compounds.info: Sodium amide is an inorganic sodium salt composed of a sodium cation and an azanide anion. It is used as a strong base in organic synthesis. It has a role as a catalyst and a nucleophilic reagent. It contains an azanide.
